:::{#def-list-decodable-code}
#### List-decodable code

Let $C$ be a [block code](error-correcting-codes.qmd#def-block-code) of length $n$ over the alphabet $\codealph$,
and let $e \ge 0$ and $L \ge 1$ be [integers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-integers).
Then $C$ is **$(e, L)$-list-decodable**
if every received word $r \in \codealph^n$
has at most $L$ codewords $c$ with $\hamdist{c}{r} \le e$.
To **list decode** a received word $r$ is to find all of those codewords.

:::
